CommunityApplications.Profile: LazyBackup is a From → To backup manager for filesystem paths, Docker volumes, database dumps, Git mirrors and LazyBackup itself, landing on this host, SSH servers, S3-compatible storage or a Bro Space peer. This repository holds the source code, the Unraid template and the release notes. Image: ghcr.io/ceneka/lazybackup:latest (amd64/arm64). Support and bug reports: https://github.com/Ceneka/lazybackup/issues
